:::{#exr-rss-ols-fit}
#### Residual sum of squares of the OLS fit

Assuming $S_{xx} > 0$ (@def-centered-sums),
write the [residual sum of squares](#def-rss)
at the OLS estimates (@thm-ols-slr),
$\text{RSS}(\hintcoef, \hcoef{x}) = \sumin \resid_\iobs^2$,
in terms of $S_{xx}$, $S_{yy}$ and $S_{xy}$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-rss-ols-fit}

The [fitted values](prediction.qmd#def-fitted-value)
of the OLS fit are $\fitted_\iobs = \hintcoef + \hcoef{x} x_i$,
so each [residual](prediction.qmd#def-residual) is

$$
\begin{aligned}
\resid_\iobs
&= \outvar_\iobs - \fitted_\iobs
&& \text{(definition of a residual)}\\
&= \outvar_\iobs - \paren{\hintcoef + \hcoef{x} x_i}
&& \text{(substitute $\fitted_\iobs$)}\\
&= \outvar_\iobs - \paren{\bar{y} - \hcoef{x} \bar{x} + \hcoef{x} x_i}
&& \text{(substitute $\hintcoef$)}\\
&= \outvar_\iobs - \bar{y} + \hcoef{x} \bar{x} - \hcoef{x} x_i
&& \text{(distribute the minus sign)}\\
&= (\outvar_\iobs - \bar{y}) - \paren{\hcoef{x} x_i - \hcoef{x} \bar{x}}
&& \text{(group terms)}\\
&= (\outvar_\iobs - \bar{y}) - \hcoef{x} (x_i - \bar{x})
&& \text{(factor out $\hcoef{x}$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

Squaring and summing:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\sumin \resid_\iobs^2
&= \sumin \paren{(\outvar_\iobs - \bar{y}) - \hcoef{x} (x_i - \bar{x})}^2
&& \text{(substitute $\resid_\iobs$)}\\
&= \sumin \paren{(\outvar_\iobs - \bar{y})^2 - 2 \hcoef{x} (x_i - \bar{x})(\outvar_\iobs - \bar{y})
  + \hcoef{x}^2 (x_i - \bar{x})^2}
&& \text{(expand the square)}\\
&= \sumin (\outvar_\iobs - \bar{y})^2 - \sumin 2 \hcoef{x} (x_i - \bar{x})(\outvar_\iobs - \bar{y})
  + \sumin \hcoef{x}^2 (x_i - \bar{x})^2
&& \text{(sum of a sum)}\\
&= \sumin (\outvar_\iobs - \bar{y})^2 - 2 \hcoef{x} \sumin (x_i - \bar{x})(\outvar_\iobs - \bar{y})
  + \sumin \hcoef{x}^2 (x_i - \bar{x})^2
&& \text{(constant factor out of the sum)}\\
&= \sumin (\outvar_\iobs - \bar{y})^2 - 2 \hcoef{x} \sumin (x_i - \bar{x})(\outvar_\iobs - \bar{y})
  + \hcoef{x}^2 \sumin (x_i - \bar{x})^2
&& \text{(constant factor out of the sum)}\\
&= S_{yy} - 2 \hcoef{x} \sumin (x_i - \bar{x})(\outvar_\iobs - \bar{y})
  + \hcoef{x}^2 \sumin (x_i - \bar{x})^2
&& \text{(definition of $S_{yy}$)}\\
&= S_{yy} - 2 \hcoef{x} S_{xy} + \hcoef{x}^2 \sumin (x_i - \bar{x})^2
&& \text{(definition of $S_{xy}$)}\\
&= S_{yy} - 2 \hcoef{x} S_{xy} + \hcoef{x}^2 S_{xx}
&& \text{(definition of $S_{xx}$)}\\
&= S_{yy} - 2 \frac{S_{xy}}{S_{xx}} S_{xy} + \paren{\frac{S_{xy}}{S_{xx}}}^2 S_{xx}
&& \text{(substitute $\hcoef{x} = S_{xy} / S_{xx}$)}\\
&= S_{yy} - 2 \frac{S_{xy}^2}{S_{xx}} + \paren{\frac{S_{xy}}{S_{xx}}}^2 S_{xx}
&& \text{(multiply)}\\
&= S_{yy} - 2 \frac{S_{xy}^2}{S_{xx}} + \frac{S_{xy}^2}{S_{xx}^2} S_{xx}
&& \text{(square of a quotient)}\\
&= S_{yy} - 2 \frac{S_{xy}^2}{S_{xx}} + \frac{S_{xy}^2}{S_{xx}}
&& \text{(cancel one factor of $S_{xx}$)}\\
&= S_{yy} - \frac{S_{xy}^2}{S_{xx}}
&& \text{(combine like terms)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
